title: Stage 0: prove Coolify Agent A2A can deploy mastra-base end-to-end
description: De-risk the builder by proving the Coolify Agent (A2A) can deploy mastra-base as a self-contained docker-compose resource and return a live public URL. Fix the agent's read tools if still broken. Output = the proven A2A deploy sequence the builder will call in Stage 1.
notes: STAGE 0 PROVEN end-to-end. mastra-base-test LIVE at https://base.191.101.15.236.sslip.io via Coolify Agent A2A. Verified: /health 200, /api/agents 401(no token)/200(JWT), leadIntake generate returns structured extraction + validateEmail tool call. Proven A2A deploy ENGINE sequence (for the builder): 1) A2A provisioner create_application(dockercompose,branch,ports_exposes 4111) -> HITL approval -> POST /approve-tool-call {runId,toolCallId}. 2) hybrid env: secrets via Coolify API (coolify app env create), ANTHROPIC from infisical /anthropic; NO NODE_ENV. 3) raw API PATCH docker_compose_location=/docker-compose.yml. 4) deploy once (parses compose). 5) raw API PATCH docker_compose_domains {svc:{name,domain}}+force_domain_override. 6) A2A trigger_deploy (NOT gated) to apply domain. Gotchas: agent PROSE hallucinates-trust tool_results; infisical --projectId needs path w/o leading slash; domains 422 until compose_raw exists.
close_reason: Stage 0 proven: deployed mastra-base-test end-to-end via Coolify Agent A2A (create+approve, hybrid env, deploy), live + JWT-gated + agent answering at https://base.191.101.15.236.sslip.io. Engine sequence captured to reference_coolify_a2a_deploy_engine.md. Template port fix in PR #2.
